title: Tech Disruptors: Affirm CEO on AI Reshaping Consumer Credit
content: Consumer credit may be approaching its foundational AI moment — with buy now, pay later emerging as the first visible act. title: Asia Bankers Fear US Scrutiny of Loans Involving Chips, China
content: Some bankers in Asia are starting to worry about financing deals that would grant Chinese end-users remote access to advanced US chips amid the escalating battle between the world’s two superpowers for artificial intelligence dominance.

title: Zambia Abandons Plan to Extend IMF Credit Facility by a Year
content: Zambia has decided against pursuing a one-year extension of its International Monetary Fund program that’s set to expire this month, the Washington-based lender said on Wednesday, an about turn that will surprise investors.

title: Santander, BBVA and Deutsche Lead $3 Billion Repo for Argentina
content: Argentina secured a $3 billion loan from a group of international banks to help cover a foreign debt payment due in two days and replenish the country’s depleted coffers.

title: Holders of $895-a-Year AmEx Card Rush to Spend Saks Perk
content: American Express card holders and other shoppers are hurrying to spend store credits and gift cards at Saks Fifth Avenue as the cash-strapped retailer heads toward a potential bankruptcy restructuring.

title: JPMorgan to Take Over Apple Credit-Card Business, Report Says
content: JPMorgan Chase & Co. will replace Goldman Sachs Group Inc. as the partner for Apple Inc.’s credit-card business, bookending Goldman’s costly foray into consumer finance.

title: Blackstone, TPG Deliver $7 Billion Test to Risky Loan Market

title: Wealth Management Platform Wealthfront Targets $2.05B Valuation In Latest Fintech IPO
content: Digital wealth management platform unicorn Wealthfront has filed for an initial public offering, lining up the Palo Alto, California-based startup to join a string of fintech IPOs in the U.S. this year.

title: Seed Funding In 2025 Broke Records Around Big Rounds And AI, With US Far In The Lead
content: The seed investment environment exhibited its typical quirkiness in 2025. In particular, it was a huge year for huge rounds. Predictably, it was also a banner period for AI dealmaking with the U.S. pulling in a bigger-than-usual share of total investment.

title: JPMorgan Chase reaches deal to become Apple Card issuer as Goldman closes chapter on consumer foray
content: JPMorgan Chase has reached a deal to take over the Apple credit card from Goldman Sachs, the two banks said late Wednesday.

title: Your past-due student loans can make it harder to rent an apartment. These 5 tips can help
content: If you've fallen behind on your student loans, it may be more challenging to get a property manager to approve you for rental housing, financial experts say.

title: Mortgage rates move higher after the Fed rate cut, causing loan demand to drop
content: Mortgage rates moved higher after the Fed cut interest rates last week. That caused demand to drop for both home buying and refinancing.

title: Esusu, platform for renters to build credit scores, valued at $1.2 billion in new funding round
content: Esusu raises $50 million at a $1.2 billion valuation as it helps more renters build credit scores and gain access to mortgages and other financial products.

title: What December's Fed rate cut means for your mortgage, credit card, auto loan, student debt and savings
content: From credit cards and car loans to mortgage rates, student loans and savings accounts, here's a look at the ways a Fed rate cut could affect your finances.

title: Refinance demand for FHA loans jumps 24%, as homeowners seek the most savings they can
content: Current homeowners are turning to government FHA loans, which offer lower interest rates, to find savings, as conventional rates turn higher.

title: What another Fed cut could mean for your personal borrowing costs
content: Many types of consumer loans are impacted when the Fed lowers its overnight lending rate, but it also depends on the product and duration.

title: Student loan forgiveness is taxable again: Start planning for the 'tax bomb,' CFP says
content: Some student loan borrowers who get their debt canceled in 2026 may be hit with a tax bill now that a law protecting the relief from levies has expired.

title: Bankruptcy success rate for student loan borrowers jumps to 87%, study finds
content: The success rate for student loan borrowers in bankruptcy has "jumped" to 87%, a study finds. But many people still don't pursue the option.

title: Over 300,000 student loan borrowers were denied a new repayment plan, court filing shows — here's why
content: Trump officials rejected 327,955 income-driven repayment plan requests from student loan borrowers, according to a recent court filing. Here's what to know.

title: Trump administration to start seizing pay of defaulted student loan borrowers in January
content: The Trump administration will start garnishing the wages of student loan borrowers in default in early January.
